hints.title: Last-In First-Out Matching
hints.text: Every opening bracket must be closed by the same type of bracket in reverse order of opening. An inner bracket pair must be matched and closed before an enclosing outer pair can close.

hints.title: Stack Invariant and Delimiter Map
hints.text: Use a stack to remember open brackets awaiting their counterparts. Map each closing bracket to its corresponding opening bracket to standardize match verification.

hints.title: Push on Open, Validate on Close
hints.text: Iterate through characters. If the character is an opening delimiter, push it onto the stack. If it is a closing delimiter, check that the stack is not empty and pop the top element, verifying it matches the required opening bracket. After processing the string, the stack must be empty.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of string s (1 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Single pass pushing and popping each character from stack at most once.

solutions.approach: LIFO Stack Matching with Delimiter Mapping
